# Macro ⇄ Calorie Calculator

> A free, no-signup, ad-free macro (macronutrient) calculator at https://macros.fyi/. Convert between grams of protein, carbohydrate, and fat and total daily calories, see your macro percentage split update live, and lock any values to solve for the rest. Runs entirely in the browser — nothing is sent to a server, and there is no tracking.

## How it works
- Calorie conversion factors: protein and carbohydrate are ~4 kcal per gram; fat is ~9 kcal per gram.
- Grams-primary: set protein/carbs/fat in grams to get total calories and the percentage split, or set a calorie target and lock 1–2 macros and/or calories to scale the unpinned macros proportionally.
- Mobile-first, accessible, and works offline once loaded.

## Why it's different
- Completely free, no account, no ads, no tracking.
- Two-way: macros ⇄ calories, with lockable constraints — most calculators are one-direction only.
- Open source.

## Links
- [Macro Calculator](https://macros.fyi/): the live tool
